en: Lightning strikes the Earth about 8 million times a day, heating the air to five times hotter than the sun's surface.
A single handful of healthy forest soil contains more living organisms than the total number of humans on Earth.
Pumice is the only rock that floats on water because it is full of trapped gas bubbles from volcanic eruptions.
Clouds look light and fluffy, but an average cumulus cloud weighs about 1.1 million pounds due to its water droplets.
A single day on Venus is longer than its entire year because the planet rotates on its axis so slowly.
Neutron stars are so incredibly dense that just one teaspoon of their material would weigh about six billion tons.
The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth at a rate of about 3.8 centimeters every single year.
Tsunamis can travel across the deep ocean as fast as a commercial jet airplane, reaching speeds up to 800 kilometers per hour.
The Atacama Desert in Chile is the driest non-polar place on Earth, with some weather stations never recording any rain.
Talc is the softest mineral on the Mohs hardness scale and is the main ingredient in commercial baby powder.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a massive storm that has been raging for over 300 years and is wider than Earth.
The supervolcano beneath Yellowstone National Park holds enough magma to cover the entire United States in a thick layer of ash.
